feed_title: Floral Bolster Dog Bed, Songbird Print on Teal, Rounded Cushioned Sides, Zipped Cover Washable at 30C, Medium and Large | PawLunova Tetbury
descriptionHtml:
Songbird print on teal. Rounded sides. Worth leaving on show.

Tetbury is a bolster dog bed with rounded cushioned sides and a songbird print on teal, in Medium and Large, with a zipped cover that washes at 30°C.

Every house has a spot the dog has already chosen. Beside a radiator, at the end of the sofa, facing the door. Usually the one corner of the room you never quite finished.

A teal bed with songbirds on it earns that corner in a way a grey rectangle never manages, and the rounded bolsters give them a soft edge to settle against.

What they get

  • Rounded bolster sides: A curved edge frames the sleeping space, with no square corner to avoid.
  • A songbird print on teal: Colour, in a category that is mostly grey.
  • A cushioned resting space: Filled and soft through the middle, where they settle.
  • A zipped cover at 30°C: It unzips, washes cool and goes back on.
  • Two sizes: Medium and Large, chosen around the space your dog really needs.

Best for: Dogs who settle against a soft edge, in a corner you want to look at.

Why it is worth the money

£89 buys the Medium and £119 the Large. The print is why people pick it up and the cover is why they keep it: teal carries a normal week better than cream, and the outer unzips and goes in at 30°C. A pattern to live with, not one to keep nice.

Now the part most shops would skip. We do not publish centimetres for Tetbury yet, and we are not going to invent them. Message us their breed and weight before you order and we will tell you honestly which one to take.

Size and fit

Two sizes, Medium and Large. Exact measurements are not listed for this bed, so ask us rather than guessing. Measure your dog lying on their side, nose to base of tail, and add 15 to 20cm, then compare against the usable space inside the sides. Not sure? Message us their breed and weight and we will tell you honestly which one fits.

Everyday care

Wash the removable cover at 30°C, following the sewn-in label. Air-dry fully before refitting.

If your dog is in pain, recovering or finding it hard to move, speak to your vet about the right resting surface. A bed is for comfort. It is not a treatment.

100 nights to decide.

Try it at home for 100 nights from delivery. If it is not right, we arrange free UK mainland collection and a full refund. One trial per household; damage and other exclusions apply. Read the full returns and guarantee terms.

Free standard UK delivery on orders over £40. Check delivery timings and any product-specific lead time.

The questions we get asked most.

How do I know which size to get?

Ask us. Send their breed and weight and we will say which one.

How much is delivery, and how quickly does it arrive?

Free standard UK delivery on orders over £40. Your estimate shows before you pay.

Can I pay in instalments?

Yes. Instalment providers are listed at checkout.

What are the exact measurements?

Not published for this bed yet, and we will not print a figure we cannot stand behind.

Will it suit an older dog who finds it hard to get up?

We describe it and your vet advises on your dog. Soft filled middle, rounded cushioned sides, not firm foam.

Can I actually wash it?

Yes. The zipped cover comes off and washes at 30°C. Let it dry fully.

What if my dog just won't use it?

Back it comes, any time in the first 100 nights. Free collection.

Pick Medium or Large and put something worth looking at in that corner.
